# DetailScales

> DetailScales builds paid acquisition and booking systems for one trade only: car detailing. Ceramic coating shops and mobile detailers.

DetailScales (https://www.detailscales.com) is a marketing and automation service for car detailing businesses. It is run by Zai Miana and built by the team behind BotLeads, which has generated $145,000 in revenue for clients running paid acquisition and booking systems for service businesses.

## Not to be confused with

DetailScales is a marketing service for car detailers. It is unrelated to scale modelling, model kits, weighing scales, or aviation publishing. Sites with similar names cover those subjects and are different organisations.

## Who it is for

Established detailing businesses that sell both ceramic coating and regular detailing, where:

- Ceramic coating or paint correction is priced at $1,500 or more per job
- There is a regular detail or wash side of the business alongside it
- A list of past customers exists, even a messy one
- At least 10 inquiries a month already arrive
- There is capacity to take on more work
- Follow-up on all of it is inconsistent

It is not for shops with no coating offer, no past customer list, no spare capacity, or anyone unwilling to hand over their customer database.

## The core idea

An empty calendar is usually not a lead problem. It is a leak problem. Inquiries go cold because nobody called back fast enough, quotes never got followed up, and past customers never heard from the business again.

## The mechanism: the Closed-Loop Booking System

Five parts, delivered in this order. The order is the mechanism, and most agencies start at part five.

1. **Dead lead recovery.** Every unclosed quote gets worked. These people already asked for a price and nothing changed except that nobody followed up. It is the fastest cash in the system.
2. **Customer reactivation.** Past detail, wash and coating customers brought back by text. They already paid and already trust the work. A detailer's wash list is the best ceramic coating audience that exists.
3. **Reviews, referrals and maintenance.** Requested automatically after every job, with coating maintenance reminders so annual decontamination and second vehicles get billed rather than forgotten.
4. **Instant lead response.** An AI voice agent calls every inquiry within 60 seconds, from any source. A coating buyer is usually pricing three shops, and the first callback tends to take the job.
5. **New customer acquisition.** Paid ads for coating and detailing, switched on last, once the follow-up exists to catch what they bring in.

## The offer

- Promise: $10,000 in added revenue within 90 days.
- Guarantee: if that is missed, the fee is refunded and the work continues free until the number is reached.
- Conditions apply and are published openly on the site, because a revenue guarantee only survives if the client covers the inputs: the customer database, system access, replies to booked calls within 24 hours, calendar availability, leaving the follow-up running as built, capacity to fulfil the work, and the agreed minimum ad spend.
- Ad spend is paid direct to the advertising platform, never through DetailScales.
- DetailScales does not describe this as risk free. The fee is refundable; the client's time and ad budget are not.

## Proof position

DetailScales is new to detailing specifically and says so. The system is proven with named clients in other trades, on camera:

- Sirvontes, a med spa owner: monthly revenue went from $20,000 to $35,000 inside 60 days with no new staff hired.
- Ali, founder of Renoir, an agency serving roofing and home improvement contractors: 15 to 28 jobs a month without extra workload or staff.
- Eric Aumen: an additional $6,250 generated while managing 10 or more clients.

Detailer-specific figures are deliberately not claimed until they exist.
